review_rules: Use only the pre-frozen concept_id values for the case.
Quote model output exactly from actual_required_identity_parts and, when useful, actual_must_preserve; do not paraphrase it.
Judge whether each required_identity_parts quote expresses the same structural concept as the pre-frozen label; must_preserve quotes are optional propagation evidence.
A confirmed concept must be structural, not merely material, colour, effect, action, or decoration.
Do not add an alias, rename a concept, or change the expected concept list after any provider call.
Quality 2 requires at least two distinct confirmed concepts in required_identity_parts and no non-structural required_identity_parts.
